fox.justification: The www-data web account switched UID to 'phopkins' (T1078.003) and used sudo to root to read /etc/shadow (T1003.008) and recursively list /root/ (T1083). The sudo working directory is inside the WordPress uploads folder of intranet.price.fox.org, indicating a web shell (T1505.003).
fox.remediation_plan:
1. Isolate 10.35.35.206 from the network (block egress and lateral SSH/SMB) while preserving volatile state; do not power off.
2. Snapshot the host and export /var/log/auth.log, /var/log/syslog and the Apache access/error logs for /var/www/intranet.price.fox.org.
3. Kill all sessions for 'phopkins' and www-data, then lock the account: pkill -u phopkins; passwd -l phopkins.
4. Hunt the web shell: find /var/www/intranet.price.fox.org/wp-content/uploads -name '*.php' and list files modified in the 72h before the alert; preserve copies as evidence, then remove.
5. Treat all local credentials as compromised: force a password reset for every account on this host and anywhere those passwords were reused.
6. Rotate host secrets reachable by root: SSH host keys and authorized_keys, wp-config.php DB credentials, API tokens, cron-embedded secrets.
7. Remove 'phopkins' from sudoers/sudo group unless the entitlement is documented and required (MITRE M1026).
8. Patch WordPress core, plugins and themes, and block PHP execution inside wp-content/uploads at the webserver (M1051, M1042).
9. Check for persistence: crontab -l for all users, /etc/cron.*, systemd units, /root/.ssh/authorized_keys, and new UID-0 entries in /etc/passwd.
10. Rule 5403 did not fire, so 'phopkins' has legitimate prior sudo use — audit that account's full sudo history rather than assuming it was attacker-created.

wilson.justification: www-data escalated to 'jwilkinson' (T1078.003) and reached root via first-time sudo (rule 5403), but the commands run were cat /etc/passwd and iptables -L — account and firewall enumeration (T1087.001, T1016) rather than a hash dump. Root access is confirmed, so this goes to IR for scoping, but no credential material was read in this window.
wilson.remediation_plan:
1. Escalate to tier-2/IR with the sudo session for 'jwilkinson' between 11:48:18 and 11:48:51 on 2022-02-07.
2. Snapshot 172.26.243.167 and export auth.log, syslog and Apache access logs for the surrounding hour before any cleanup.
3. Hunt the web shell in /var/www/intranet.hallbrown.wilson.com/wp-content/uploads (recent PHP files, uploads modified in the last 72h); preserve copies.
4. Suspend the session and account pending confirmation with the owner: pkill -u jwilkinson; passwd -l jwilkinson.
5. iptables -L was run as root: diff the live firewall ruleset against the approved baseline and alert on any rule added after 11:48 on 2022-02-07.
6. Confirm no hash access occurred — check auth.log and auditd execve records for later /etc/shadow reads; if found, re-grade to critical and switch to containment.
7. Review and remove the 'jwilkinson' sudo entitlement if undocumented (MITRE M1026).
8. Patch WordPress core/plugins/themes and block PHP execution in wp-content/uploads (M1051, M1042).
